landing.headline: One workspace for an independent consultant.
landing.lead: Bookings, meetings and emails turned into tasks, a task board, a weekly timeline and alerts. Built for someone who works for a partner firm and for her own clients at the same time.
landing.demo: Demo data only: every person, company and email address here is invented.

approvals.title: Nothing reaches the board without approval
approvals.text: Meeting notes and emails are summarized into topics, decisions and candidate tasks. Each one needs Approve or No action.

board.title: A board that knows which side it is on
board.text: Every task carries its client and whether it is partner firm work or your own. Filter, sort and share it over a token API.

timeline.title: A week you can hand in
timeline.text: Drag tasks into the week, process it into a report, and sync it to the calendar as busy time in one click.

alerts.title: A cron that watches the cron
alerts.text: Editable alert rules, an outbox that cannot fail, and scheduled jobs that notice when one of them stops.
